name: @vnkr-labs/icons-eps
description: A set of free MIT-licensed high-quality SVG icons for you to use in your web projects.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run copy:license && pnpm run build:icons
scripts.clean: find dist -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null; rm -rf dist && find . ! -name '.gitkeep' -path '*/icons/*' -exec rm -rf {} +
